system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: facts extracted at session close, recalled into the system prompt on the next connection
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt augmented at runtime by long-term memory recall and skills.

env_context_strategy.note: Virtual filesystem tools; opt-in RAG via SemanticRecallInterceptor/ContextProvider.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Multi-turn history on, sliding-window compaction by default.
context_compaction.note: Default sliding-window; `-Dorg.atmosphere.ai.compaction=summarizing` selectable; large-tool-output disk offload on by default.

observation_format.evidence_quote: tool calling, JSON mode, vision, audio, prompt caching, token usage, native retry, tool-call deltas
observation_format.note: Vision capability implies images reachable; default tool results are text.

tool_call_format.note: Provider tool calling per adapter capability 'tool calling'.

tool_count.note: write_todos + six filesystem tools + delegate_task (task on Coordinator); plus code_exec opt-in and user @AiTool methods.

edit_primitive.note: edit_file coded as search_replace, write_file as whole_file_rewrite; exact semantics not shown.

tool_schema_source.note: Annotation-declared names/descriptions; MCP tool sources via McpToolSource.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: verifies LLM-emitted tool workflows before execution
loop_primitives.note: Plan-and-verify and write_todos plan; Atmosphere is an event-driven framework.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A plain `@Agent` is batteries-included — memory, a plan (`write_todos`), a virtual filesystem, and sub-agent delegation (`task`), on by default via the
planning_granularity.note: README states a plan via write_todos is on by default; no line number available in excerpt; plan object structure not shown in code.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: On a `@Coordinator`, a built-in `delegate_task` tool plus default-on outbound-dispatch governance.
multi_agent_topology.note: A plain @Agent is single; orchestrator_workers reachable via @Coordinator/AgentFleet.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: `delegate_task` for pre-declared fleet members and `task` to spawn an ephemeral, isolated sub-agent on demand
delegation_mechanism.note: DELEGATION is part of Harness.ALL default.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: command confirmations, permission modes, tool approval policies

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Unified SPI for conversation history, durable facts, daily notes, working memory, and hierarchical rules.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: facts extracted at session close, recalled into the system prompt on the next connection
long_term_memory.note: File-backed AgentState default; skills via META-INF/skills; SemanticRecallInterceptor for BYO vector store.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Durable sessions, run IDs, replay buffers, checkpoints, and reconnect-safe continuation

self_verification.evidence_quote: a seventh SMT backend ships as `atmosphere-verifier-smt` (SMTInterpol pure-JVM default, Z3 opt-in via native libs) proving numeric invariants
self_verification.note: LlmJudge / ResultEvaluator ship; plan-and-verify structural verifiers are formal-ish.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: tool loop capped at five rounds, cancellation-aware
retry_policy.note: Only per-request retry (transport) documented; no task-level retry policy.

rollback.note: Closest value: checkpoint/fork restore; no git or filesystem revert documented. E3 value list lacks 'checkpoint'; coded snapshot-like as none-fit — see note.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: tool loop capped at five rounds, cancellation-aware
termination_condition.note: cost ceilings per tenant; max_steps from tool-loop cap (Anthropic adapter).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: stream-level PII redaction, token usage, per-tenant cost ceilings
cost_controls.note: Prompt caching on by default; AiGateway built on router/budget machinery.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Default limits: 1 CPU · 512 MB · 5 min wall · no network.
timeouts.note: Sandbox per-invocation timeouts; no run-level timeout documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: `InProcessSandboxProvider` is a dev-only reference backend — not a security boundary.
execution_isolation.note: Agent tools run in the JVM process by default; code execution is default-off, and when enabled DockerSandboxProvider (container) is the production default.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: a bounded, conversation-scoped file store under the agent workspace
filesystem_access.note: Relative to JVM process boundary; virtual FS tools are bounded to workspace.

network_policy.evidence_quote: 1 CPU · 512 MB · 5 min wall · no network
network_policy.note: Sandbox default is no network; host JVM itself unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: `GovernancePolicy`, `PolicyRing`, allow/deny lists, rate limits, time windows, metadata requirements
permission_model.note: Policy admission on the critical path; per-tool @RequiresApproval and PermissionMode also available.

tracing.evidence_quote: One admission point for per-user rate limiting, per-user credential resolution, and unified trace emission.
tracing.note: GatewayTraceExporter pluggable, noop() default; observability reference docs.

replayability.evidence_quote: records session-boundary AI events (SQLite-durable) — reconstruct a run or a coordination tree with no model call

eval_hooks.note: Eval dashboard in admin; no standard benchmark runner (e.g. SWE-bench) shipped.

guardrails.evidence_quote: `@AgentScope` blocks out-of-purpose prompts before runtime dispatch
guardrails.note: PII redaction = output filter; verifier/policy admission = action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Portable AI agent runtime for the JVM.
target_domain.note: General agent runtime with MCP tools; coding-agent sample covers swe.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: One `AgentRuntime` SPI with twelve runtime adapters and contract-tested capability flags
